params.note: Synthesized recreation (SQUELCH's 808 worklet). The beat is an original electro-style pattern, not taken from any record. The kick is a sine with a fast pitch drop, the snare a tuned body plus filtered noise, the clap a burst of noise gated three times then a tail.

caption.age7: Press the buttons. These are the drum sounds from a machine, not a real drum kit.
caption.age13: Turn the kick's decay all the way up. It stops sounding like a drum hit and rings on like a bass note. That trick is behind a lot of hip-hop's low end.
caption.adult: Synthesized approximation of the TR-808 voice architecture. The 808's kick has tone and decay controls but no tuning; the long decay is the specific parameter that reframed the machine's perceived weakness as its value.
